paragraphs.text: Pontotoc beat host Lafayette 49–48 in Oxford on Thursday, November 5, winning a football game that was tied entering the fourth quarter.
Markavion Jones rushed for 301 yards and three touchdowns on 20 carries, according to the game statistics posted on MaxPreps.
The quarter-by-quarter box score shows the teams level at 28–28 after three periods. Pontotoc scored 21 points in the fourth quarter, while Lafayette scored 20.
The win moved the Warriors to 8–2. Lafayette fell to 8–3.
